### RT-02 policy/admission and delivery dependency audit

- **DAG:** `RT-02` now has inbound edges from H9 policy/admission evidence, CR-004 verified binding, H10 delivery mechanics, CR-009/CR-010 inputs, and REL-01 (`IP-02-dependency-report.md:118-124`).
- **Critical path:** the delivery branch explicitly requires H3 verified binding + H9 policy/admission + H10 delivery mechanics + CR-009/CR-010 inputs before RT-02 (`:157-161`).
- **Parallel lane:** L-G repeats all prerequisites and fails closed—no enqueue/send if any policy, binding, snapshot, kill-switch, outbox, idempotency, revalidation, receipt, or recovery evidence is absent (`:163-174`).
- **Architecture gates:** H9 explicitly blocks both RT-01 and RT-02, while H10 is explicitly additional to H9 and cannot replace it (`:178-194`).
